name: Why is my shower's water pressure low, and how can it be fixed?

mainEntity.name: Why is my shower's water pressure low, and how can it be fixed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low water pressure in a shower can be caused by various factors, including clogged showerheads, mineral buildup in pipes, faulty pressure regulators, or even issues with your home's main water supply line. Fixing it often starts with checking and cleaning the showerhead. If that doesn't resolve it, further investigation into the plumbing system is needed to identify and address blockages or faulty components. Our service technicians can diagnose whether the issue is localized to your shower or a broader plumbing system problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low shower pressure can result from clogged showerheads, mineral buildup, or faulty regulators. Solutions range from cleaning to pipe repair.
